title: Watch Mardi Gras from the parade route
description: Find a seat along a New Orleans parade route and let the celebration come to you: marching bands, elaborate floats, costumed riders, and neighbors calling for beads and throws. Grandstand seating gives you a fixed spot to return to as the procession rolls past, with room to take in the details of each krewe’s work.
teaser: Settle in for the color and music of a New Orleans parade.
goodToKnow: Mardi Gras Day is February 9, 2027. Check each krewe’s parade route and reserve grandstand seating early.
whyItMightDelightYou: A reserved place makes it easier to linger, people-watch, and share the spectacle with your companions.
